content:
# Today's the day. The "is, was, and always will be" EP is now also available on Bandcamp. Entirely coincidentally, it's #bandcampfriday.

You know what to do! 🫠

The listening party is scheduled for 8pm UK next Friday, 11th September. I hope you can join me.

# It really doesn't feel like only two weeks since I initially released "is, was, and always will be" on subvert.fm — it seems like so much longer.

It's been a crazy couple of weeks, sure, but that doesn't nearly account for it. 1

Maybe it's because I started work on the EP back in May (finishing the first track in June) and have mentally moved on. Having the next project well underway no doubt exacerbates that.

I always get so hyped for what I'm currently working on that everything else takes a back seat in my brain — it takes a while for me to come back and appreciate it.

The staggered release (with the two week exclusive on subvert) has thrown me. It also wasn't a particularly successful experiment; in one day on Bandcamp I've already almost matched the total plays from the time on subvert.

Still, it's early days for the platform and more people need to start using it.

  1. maybe I'll post about some of that at a later date  ↩
